Replace the example with your own idea. If your AI cannot open links, give it the downloaded skill package. It runs in your own AI tool; this website does not host a model or require an API key.

Steer what you see

Fine or coarse. Sparse or dense. Gentle or sharp turns. Work with controls that describe the visible result, then learn the method as you explore.

Keep a variation

The offline starter saves its seed, parameters and algorithm version. Export a PNG, a recipe you can reopen, or a working HTML file you can share.

Follow the contribution

Credits connect a method to people and their specific roles. Institutions and tools provide context. A useful new label can be suggested without rewriting history.

This first release includes one finished direction-field study and guidance for creating other algorithms. The starter uses an original interpolated direction field; it is not a Perlin-noise implementation. The skill is designed for clearer control and attribution; comparative aesthetic quality has not been established.
